title: Conditionally show/hide a widget

comments.body:
I think it is time to rething about (not for V1):
- widget instance methods (hide, show, refine from outside?)
- widget events (hide, show, refine event?)
- widget public properties (.container?)

Because your particular need emphasis that this could be handled by a generic API rather than inventing more and more API methods for specific needs.

Ref #83 

What do you think?

Agreed with @vvo. Next version should have emphasis on event and public methods/properties of container. I feel that this specific use case should be handle by the users, listening to events and interacting with its widgets, but we should give them the flexibility to do so.
Yes works for me so I am closing this since there is already #83
